info.name: Farmacore
info.description: HTTP surface for the Farmacore API. Kept in sync with `plans/` — every plan that touches a controller updates this file. Use the `baseUrl` and `tenantSlug` collection variables.

request.description: Public liveness endpoint. Returns `{ "status": "ok" }`. Defined in `src/health/health.controller.ts` (Plan 00 / 07). Marked @Public() so the global JwtAuthGuard does not block it.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Plan 02 — `src/auth/auth.controller.ts`. Login, refresh, logout, and current user.

request.description: Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`. The test script stores both tokens as collection variables for subsequent requests.

Log in as a TENANT admin (non-system). Use the tenant's slug + the oneTimePassword returned by POST /admin/tenants. The resulting token works on /auth/* and /products/* but NOT on /admin/* (those require a system-admin token). Stores accessToken/refreshToken like the system login.
Rotates the refresh token; returns new `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`.
Returns the decoded JwtPayload (`sub`, `tenantId`, `role`). Bearer token required.
Revokes the current user's outstanding refresh tokens. 204 No Content on success.

item.name: Admin — Tenants
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/tenants.controller.ts`. All routes require a token whose tenantId === 'system' and role === 'admin' (SystemAdminGuard).

request.description: Onboards a tenant: writes core.tenant row, creates the schema, runs tenant template migrations, seeds tenant_competitor_origin rows, and creates an initial admin user with a one-time random password. Returns `{ slug, schemaName, initialAdminUser: { email, oneTimePassword } }`.
Lists all tenants ordered by slug.
Returns one tenant row by slug. 404 if not found.
Changes status. One of `active | paused | suspended`.
Soft-delete: sets `status=suspended` and stamps `deleted_at`. The 30-day grace + R2 dump + schema drop is a follow-up (see Plan 06 open questions).

Upserts the tenant's ERP connection. `origin` selects the vendor entity set (v1: `a7pharma`). Password is encrypted with AES-256-GCM via CredentialEncryptionService. Invalidates the per-tenant DataSource cache. Returns `{ status }`. Optional apiBaseUrl + apiKey enable A7Pharma REST write-back (price/offer); apiKey is encrypted at rest.
Connects to the stored ERP and runs `SELECT 1`. Persists `last_verified_at` on success or `last_error` on failure. Returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.
Marks the connection `status=disabled` and invalidates the cache.

item.name: Admin — Competitor origins
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/competitor-origins.controller.ts`. Bulk update of `tenant_competitor_origin` rows in the tenant's schema.

request.description: Bulk-set which competitors the tenant scrapes. Each entry `{ origin, enabled, priority?, config? }`. UPDATE-only — rows are seeded (disabled) on tenant onboarding. Stored in `core.tenant_competitor_origin` keyed by tenant_id.

item.name: Admin — Pipeline
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/pipeline.controller.ts`. Triggers the full pipeline run or a single routine.

request.description: Publishes a `pipeline.start` AMQP message for the tenant — runs the WHOLE step graph, chaining successors. Returns `{ pipelineRunId }`. Track progress in `core.pipeline_run`.
Lists the routines an admin can trigger individually. Returns `{ steps: [...] }` (the PipelineStep enum values).

Runs a single routine IN ISOLATION (the `standalone` flag suppresses its successors, so nothing downstream cascades). New run id per call. `:step` must be one of the values from GET …/pipeline/steps (e.g. `sync-base-product`, `import-competitor-products`); 400 otherwise. Returns `{ pipelineRunId, step }`.

item.name: Admin — DLQ
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/dlq.controller.ts`. Inspect and replay messages in `<step>.dlq`.

request.description: Lists every queue whose DLQ can be peeked/replayed — returns `{ queues: [...] }`. Use one of these names as `:queue` (e.g. `import-competitor-products.DROGAL`, `sync-base-product.batch`) in the requests below.
Peek without consuming: basicGet + nack(requeue=true). Returns up to `limit` messages with `{ routingKey, body, redelivered, headers }`. `step` must match `PipelineStep`.
Pops up to `max` messages from `<step>.dlq` and re-publishes them to the main exchange with `attempt=1`. Returns `{ replayed }`.

item.name: Admin — Trigger competitors (each)

request.description: Step 1 — enable just DROGAL (disable the rest), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only DROGAL.
Step 1 — enable just DROGASIL (disable the rest), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only DROGASIL.
Step 1 — enable just MICHELASSI (disable the rest), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only MICHELASSI.
Step 1 — enable just PAGUE_MENOS (disable the rest), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only PAGUE_MENOS.
Step 1 — enable just IKESAKI (disable the rest), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only IKESAKI.

Step 2 — run the competitor-products step IN ISOLATION (standalone: no downstream cascade) for whatever origins are currently enabled. Per-product it scrapes product → stock (Drogal/Drogasil) → image. Returns `{ pipelineRunId, step }`. There is no per-origin route — granularity comes from toggling origins in step 1.

item.description: Trigger one competitor at a time: run **1. Enable only <ORIGIN>** then **2. Run import-competitor-products**. To run all enabled at once use `Admin — Pipeline → pipeline/start` (full run) or this step trigger with all origins enabled.

item.name: Admin — Catalog (shared catalog ops)

request.description: Live-scrape EVERY implemented competitor for one EAN, persist into shared_catalog (product, product_image→R2, product_stock, base_product), and return the merged cross-origin view. JWT-guarded, not tenant-scoped (the catalog is global). `:ean` must be numeric.

Paginated bulk export of shared_catalog competitor data: each product with its primary image + latest stock. `origin` optional (one of DROGAL/DROGASIL/MICHELASSI/PAGUE_MENOS/IKESAKI); `limit` ≤ 1000. JWT-guarded.

item.description: System-admin ops on the GLOBAL shared catalog. Not tenant data.

item.name: Tenant — Catalog
item.description: The authenticated tenant's OWN products (scoped by JWT). Any tenant user (viewer/operator/admin). Log in via Auth → POST /auth/login (tenant admin) with your tenantSlug first.

request.description: Tenant catalog list (no competitor cross). Filters: name, supplier, classification, eans (csv), status (csv), monitored. Returns { rows, count, page, perPage }.

Tenant products CROSSED with competitors: per row cost/price/margin/status + targetPrice + drogal/drogasil/michelassi prices & observations. Same filters as /products plus sortBy (ean,name,supplier,classification,cost,price,margin,averageVariation,status,targetPrice,receiptDate).
Per-product stock: own stock total + by-subsidiary vs each competitor's latest stock, plus derived stockStatus (OK / POTENTIAL / ANALYZE_INCLUSION). perPage <= 200.
Aggregate stock coverage over the filtered set: total, ownWithStock, {drogal,drogasil,michelassi}WithStock.
Edit a tenant product's fields (operator/admin). NOT price — use /price. curve/book/mat deferred.
Set sell price (operator/admin): pushes to A7Pharma (POST /webapi/api/preco/) then mirrors locally. 409 if monitored, no ERP external_id, or no A7Pharma API configured for the tenant.
Soft-delete (active=false). Admin only.
Crossed products with a deal — competitor observation (DROGAL/DROGASIL) OR tenant deals. Includes deals + drogalDeal/drogasilDeal text.
Distinct active ingredients in the tenant catalog: { activeIngredients: [...] }.
Products grouped by active ingredient (paginated by ingredient): each group has variants (with drogal/drogasil prices) + targetPrice (min variant price).
Generic products still missing an active ingredient (need manual fill).
Tenant catalog crossed with competitors as CSV (text/csv, capped 50k). Filters same as /products.

Upsert an offer (operator/admin). Pushes precoOferta to the product's caderno on A7Pharma (idCadernoOferta=cadernoId, idEmbalagem=product.external_id), then mirrors it in tenant.offer_book. 409 if product has no ERP id or the tenant has no A7Pharma API configured.
Remove the offer (operator/admin). Sends precoOferta=null to the caderno on A7Pharma, then deletes the local offer_book row. 404 if no offer exists.
Variation-status thresholds used to classify OK/ATENÇÃO/SUSPEITA. Returns the tenant's stored values merged with defaults {suspectBelow:-15, attentionBelow:0, attentionAbove:20, suspectAbove:50}.
Update one or more thresholds (ADMIN). Send only the fields you want to change; the rest are preserved. Returns the full merged set.
Flat list of the tenant's classifications: [{ id, name, parentId, visible }] ordered by name.
Classifications as a one-level tree: root nodes each with a `children` array. FE renders this directly.
List price-rounding rules for the tenant, each with its decimal-range buckets, ordered by priority.
One price-rounding rule with its ranges. 404 if not this tenant's rule.
Create a price-rounding rule (ADMIN). `ranges` are decimal buckets: a product's price decimals in [minDecimal,maxDecimal] round to targetDecimal.
Update a rule (ADMIN). Omitted scalar fields are preserved; if `ranges` is provided it replaces all buckets wholesale.
Delete a rule and its ranges (ADMIN, cascade).

item.name: Tenant — Offer Book Rules
item.description: Preview de regras de preço (port da rotina offer-book-rules do legado). `POST /offer-book-rules/preview` calcula o preço final por produto a partir de regras + travas de margem (+ arredondamento), SEM persistir. `src/tenant-api/offer-book-rules/`. Rode 'POST /auth/login (tenant admin)' antes para preencher o accessToken.

exec: pm.test('row has finalPrice', () => b.rows.length === 0 || typeof b.rows[0].finalPrice === 'number');

request.description: Base = preço de venda. Aplica 10% de desconto sobre os EANs informados. Exclusivo com `classifications`. `@Roles(OPERATOR, ADMIN)`.

exec: pm.test('row has finalPrice', () => b.rows.length === 0 || typeof b.rows[0].finalPrice === 'number');

request.description: Base = preço de oferta (offer_book.target_price, cai pro preço de venda se não houver). Regra só para preço >= 10, trava de margem mínima 25% e arredondamento (core.price_rounding_*).

exec: pm.test('row has finalPrice', () => b.rows.length === 0 || typeof b.rows[0].finalPrice === 'number');

request.description: Base = menor preço entre as fontes (OWN_PRICE = preço próprio/oferta; demais = concorrentes em shared_catalog.product). priceBaseSources é OBRIGATÓRIO nesse modo. Produto sem preço competitivo volta com skippedNoCompetitorPrice=true.

exec: pm.test('400 quando eans e classifications vêm juntos', () => pm.response.code === 400);

request.description: Exemplo de erro de validação: mandar `eans` e `classifications` ao mesmo tempo retorna 400. Mande exatamente um dos dois.
Cria uma regra salva. Alvo por classifications XOR eans. OPERATOR/ADMIN. Salva o id em {{ruleId}}.
Lista regras (paginado). Filtros: name (ILIKE), enabled.
Detalhe da regra + suas pricingRules e priceLocks.
Atualiza a regra. Arrays (pricingRules/priceLocks/eans) substituem por completo. OPERATOR/ADMIN.
Roda o motor sobre os produtos-alvo da regra salva (mesma resposta paginada do preview ad-hoc).
Lista os produtos que a regra mira (preço/margem/custo atuais, sem aplicar a regra).
CSV do preview da regra salva.
CSV do preview de uma config não salva. OPERATOR/ADMIN.
Lista relatórios de execução. Filtros: ruleId, executionType (MANUAL/SCHEDULED), outcome (SUCCESS/FAILURE/NO_CHANGES), startDate, endDate.
Um relatório + seus itens paginados (filtro name nos itens). Setar {{reportId}}.
Histórico de execuções de uma regra (paginado).

Aplica os preços calculados como PREÇO DE OFERTA no caderno (cadernoId) da regra, no ERP (A7Pharma), em lote, e grava um relatório de execução. Irreversível. OPERATOR/ADMIN. 400 se a regra não tem cadernoId; 409 se o tenant não tem A7Pharma configurado. A regra precisa ter sido criada com cadernoId.
Apaga a regra (cascade nos filhos + relatórios). ADMIN.
